name: backlink-guard
description: Check a link source before you submit your site to it: skip, look first, free only or submit, with the evidence, against Google's link spam policies. Also verifies a listing once it is live and audits your own backlinks.

glasser_api_key.title: Glasser API key
glasser_api_key.description: The first choice for the paid checks: spam scores, Google search history, backlinks, competitors' links, AI Overviews. verify, submissions and vet with free=True work without any key. A key: https://link.glasser.ai/JasonZhu (referral link)

aisa_api_key.title: AIsa API key (optional)
aisa_api_key.description: The same checks when there is no Glasser key, and the only source of questions, asked and --deep's Ahrefs and Semrush numbers. A key: https://go.aisa.one/yansen-zhu (referral link)

goanyapi_api_key.title: GoAnyAPI API key (optional)
goanyapi_api_key.description: A site's rating, a year of visits and whether Google still lists it. A key: https://goanyapi.com/r/ga-95708898fb (referral link)
